test_title: PYST 1: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that corrects the misspelt words in the given sentence.

We have to relie on meaningful contont now.

options.text: We have to relie on meaningful content now.
We have to rely on meaningful cuntent now.
We have to rely on meaningful contont now.
We have to rely on meaningful content now.

solution:
The correct answer is '**We have to rely on meaningful content now.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the English dictionary the correct spellings are **'rely'** and **'content'.**

 Option 1) We have to relie on meaningful content now: Only one spelling is corrected.

 Option 2) We have to rely on meaningful cuntent now: Only one spelling is corrected.

 Option 3) We have to rely on meaningful contont now: Only one spelling is corrected.

 Option 4) We have to rely on meaningful content now: Both the spellings are corrected.
 
• Correct sentence__: We have to **rely** on meaningful **content** now.
